method: ROM table and Thumb input-mask inspection, plus headless emulation of every table entry. Names cross-checked against public decompilation metadata; input evidence is decoded from the uploaded Japanese ROM.
notes: 250 entries include duplicate and internal variant scenes; this is not 250 distinct marketed microgames.
Each scene sampled at the initial difficulty; this is not an all-level or all-boss completion run.
Decoded button masks are static evidence, not a complete control-flow proof. Empty masks remain unspecified.
Frame hashes identify private research captures. No ROM, reference graphics, audio, or disassembled code is packaged with the game.
